subject: Pipe-to-quota healthcheck & account velocity corrections
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pipe-to-quota healthcheck & account velocity corrections

Team —

Attached: Q1_runrate_model_v2.xlsx (tab: ‘account_velocity’)

Quick summary: our current committed + probable pipeline for Q2 sits at $2.48M vs quota of $3.2M (~0.78x). Top-10 accounts represent ~63% of the pipe; a handful are high concentration deals showing velocity degradation over the last three weeks. If we don’t clean up stage/probability assumptions, finance will need to assume a heavier conservative haircut for revenue recognition.

Action asks (please):
- Marcus: take the lead on a 15-minute sweep for the 12 largest deals and update SFDC probabilities by EOB Friday 3/22. Mark deals you recommend moving to “commit-at-risk” and add a 1-line reason.
- Rishi: once Marcus flags the list, please produce a one-page commit list for finance and include expected PO/contract cadence.
- Laura: we need your call on whether to keep coverage target at 1.0x or move to 1.05x given concentration risk. If you want a different haircut approach, let us know now.

Notes/observations I pulled into the model:
- ApexCloud (RDW-2947) currently showing 60% probability at $620k; buyer CFO has sign-off open but procurement requested a custom data-retention T&Cs — looks like a week’s delay. Recommended probability -> 35% until DocuSign is triggered.
- Two midsize deals in ‘Negotiation’ have not had an updated milestone in >10 days; recommend we triage owner activity.

Goal: get a reconciled pipe that finance can use for the Q2 run-rate and PS backlog planning by next Wednesday 3/27. If we can land probability adjustments and a short commit list, we should avoid a mid-quarter conservative reforecast.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---
References: HubSpot HS-12458 attached in model.

- For the two Negotiation deals that are stale: I’ll ping the AE owners and ask for a milestone refresh; if we don’t hear back in 48 hours I’ll flag them as ‘outside-commit’.

1) Given >60% concentration in the top 10, please assume a coverage target of 1.05x for now; that protects against 1-2 multi-hundred-K deals slipping. We’ll revisit after the sweep.
2) Please export a commit-only list (Name / Close date / ARR / Probability) and share to FP&A. I attached a short summary PDF with the sensitivity bands I’d use to model the runway.
